viewing_check: Weigh it (grams decide everything: read the max off the scale). Look inside the shank for 9ct/375 and hallmarks, check the size and that the shank isn't worn thin or split. If unstamped, ask for an acid test.
rate_note: All figures taken as AUD as printed in the database; the UK Denhams records show only $ so currency should be confirmed.
